mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_favorite_stats (edition_key, favorite_count, create_time, create_user, delete_flag) VALUES (#{et.editionKey}, #{et.favoriteCount}, #{et.createTime}, #{et.createUser}, #{et.deleteFlag}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE edition_key = edition_key
mapper.update: UPDATE book_favorite_stats SET favorite_count = favorite_count - 1, update_time = #{et.updateTime}, update_user = #{et.updateUser} WHERE edition_key = #{et.editionKey} AND delete_flag = 'NOT_DELETE' AND favorite_count > 0
